name: Zapier App Directory

sources.title: Zapier integration builder docs — build via Visual Builder or CLI, then deploy/test/promote to the app marketplace
Zapier Integration Builder entry point (requires JavaScript to load)

conditions: No fee to build or publish an integration, but a public App Directory listing requires building a real working integration and passing Zapier's app review
The product must expose a usable API for triggers/actions — this is an integration marketplace, not a generic listing
requirements: A SaaS/product with a public API that can support Zapier triggers, actions, or searches
Working authentication (API key, OAuth, etc.) for the integration
Completion of the integration review before the app is public in the directory
preparation: Decide build tool: Visual Builder (developer.zapier.com, no-code) vs Zapier CLI for custom code
API docs, auth method, and at least one working trigger/action/search
App name, description, logo, and category for the directory listing
A handful of real users/testers helps the review go smoothly
workflow: Sign in at https://developer.zapier.com (JS-required dashboard) to create an integration
Build the integration in the Visual Builder or via the Zapier CLI (auth, triggers, actions)
Test the integration end-to-end inside Zapier
Submit the app version for publication review to become listed in the Zapier App Directory
After approval, maintain the integration and respond to Zapier's quality/monitoring requirements
watchFor: developer.zapier.com is a JS app — automation must handle the dashboard flow, not raw HTML forms
Public listing requires ongoing quality; Zapier can contact/delist integrations that break
Batch claims link=nofollow — plausible but not verified on the directory page itself
This is a multi-week engineering+review effort, not a quick directory drop
countsAsLive: A public app page exists at zapier.com/apps/<slug>/integrations (or the app appears in the App Directory search) after review approval
unknowns: Current app-review turnaround and minimum user-count requirements for public listing
Whether the directory listing's website link is nofollow
Zapier's current partner/pricing tiers for promoted placement
